Catalog.description:
Keyed resources and catalogs; paths retain transfer-root semantics.

Map keys are registered names. Links are recognized before union validation
so an extensible inline Catalog cannot absorb a malformed descriptor link.

catalogs.description: Nested catalogs keyed by stable registered names. Each value is an inline catalog or a local descriptor link; catalog targets can be inherited by descendants.
catalogs.title: Catalogs

description.description: Human-readable explanation of this artifact or catalog and its purpose.
examples: Report inputs and publication destinations for the monthly release.
description.title: Description

entityType.description: Optional artifact entity kind using OpenMetadata-style names; commonly File, Directory, or Container.
entityType.title: Entitytype

path.description: Local artifact or directory path relative to the transfer root (current working directory by default). A catalog path anchors inherited target paths.
path.title: Path

pathTemplate.description: Input alias for resourcePathTemplate; saved using the canonical spelling.
pathTemplate.title: Resourcepathtemplate

profile.description: Catalog metadata profile identifier. This is unrelated to authentication profiles or a location's authProfile.
profile.title: Profile

resourcePathTemplate.description: Parse pattern for resource pathProperties, relative to this catalog path unless it is an absolute path or URI. Transfers do not expand it.
resourcePathTemplate.title: Resourcepathtemplate

resources.description: Resources keyed by stable registered names. Names form selectors such as resources.report; put display text in each resource's title.
resources.title: Resources

sources.description: Upstream inputs or provenance. Pull requires exactly one remote source per selected artifact; sources never select publication destinations.
sources.title: Sources

targets.description: Publication destinations. Omitted or null inherits the nearest catalog's targets; an empty list opts out. Explicit child targets replace inherited targets.
targets.title: Targets

title.description: Human-readable display title. Stable selectors use the resource/catalog map key.
title.title: Title

Catalog.title: Fileroute catalog

CatalogLink.description: Link to a local catalog document, relative to its containing file.

descriptor.description: Local YAML/JSON catalog document path, relative to the containing descriptor. URLs and URI fragments are not supported; links expand only when requested.
descriptor.title: Descriptor

CatalogLink.title: Local catalog link

Location.description:
Upstream input or downstream destination, with optional provider metadata.

``path`` may be a local provenance file or remote URL. ``serviceType`` uses
OpenMetadata's drive service vocabulary; it is resolved only for transfers.

authProfile.description: Local authentication profile name, overriding the run's profile default. Credentials stay outside the descriptor. Static schemas check the name pattern; they do not discover private profile names or verify the identity.
authProfile.title: Authprofile

bucket.description: S3 bucket namespace, required for S3 paths that are not full URLs.
bucket.title: Bucket

drive.description: SharePoint document-library name or Google Drive name. Use My Drive for the user's Google Drive; duplicate names may require driveId.
drive.title: Drive

driveId.description: Resolved SharePoint or Google shared-drive identifier, used to scope item lookup.
driveId.title: Driveid

entityType.description: Provider entity kind, commonly File, Directory, or Container. A resource target marked Directory/Container receives the local filename below that destination.
entityType.title: Entitytype

path.description: Authored remote URL or provider-scoped path. A source may also be a local provenance path; pull requires a supported remote source.
path.title: Path

remotePath.description: Supplemental path within the remote namespace. Resolution may derive it without changing the authored path; parent traversal is not allowed.
remotePath.title: Remotepath

serviceId.description: Provider item identifier, preferred over path lookup when present. Online resolution can populate it; S3 uses bucket:key.
serviceId.title: Serviceid

serviceType.description: Remote provider. Supported URLs infer this during offline resolution; provider-scoped paths require an explicit serviceType.

site.description: SharePoint site name for scoped lookup, used with drive or driveId.
site.title: Site

siteId.description: Resolved Microsoft Graph site identifier. Avoids repeating site-name lookup.
siteId.title: Siteid

Location.title: Source or target location

Resource.description: A materialized artifact and its provenance/publication locations.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of this artifact or catalog and its purpose.
examples: Report inputs and publication destinations for the monthly release.
description.title: Description

entityType.description: Optional artifact entity kind using OpenMetadata-style names; commonly File, Directory, or Container.
entityType.title: Entitytype

format.description: Optional file format metadata; this does not convert or transform the artifact.
format.title: Format

path.description: Required local artifact file path relative to the transfer root. Pull materializes this file; push publishes this file to targets.
path.title: Path

pathProperties.description: Named values extracted from the nearest catalog resourcePathTemplate during resolution.
pathProperties.title: Pathproperties

sources.description: Upstream inputs or provenance. Pull requires exactly one remote source per selected artifact; sources never select publication destinations.
sources.title: Sources

targets.description: Publication destinations. Omitted or null inherits the nearest catalog's targets; an empty list opts out. Explicit child targets replace inherited targets.
targets.title: Targets

title.description: Human-readable display title. Stable selectors use the resource/catalog map key.
title.title: Title

Resource.title: Catalog resource
